validation_methodology: Date-grouped expanding-window chronological CV (3 folds) + 4-origin recursive rolling backtest

model_explanations.Naive Baseline (t-1): Predicts previous day's demand verbatim (Test MAE=61.0627, RMSE=161.1743, R2=-0.5643).
model_explanations.Seasonal Naive Baseline (t-7): Predicts demand from the same weekday 7 days earlier (Test MAE=53.8403, RMSE=164.3912, R2=-0.6273).
model_explanations.Ridge Regression: Ridge Regression [SELECTED CHAMPION via Chronological CV] using 'chronological_target' encoding. CV RMSE=98.7321 (Train RMSE=97.6733, Test MAE=43.8456, RMSE=115.7574, R2=0.1931); outperforms Seasonal Naive baseline RMSE (164.3912).
model_explanations.Random Forest: Random Forest using 'chronological_target' encoding. CV RMSE=105.3517 (Train RMSE=84.6117, Test MAE=47.4632, RMSE=119.7101, R2=0.1371); outperforms Seasonal Naive baseline RMSE (164.3912).
